findings: Mute is not pause: it invokes WebContents::SetAudioMuted only. WasHidden documents stopping layout/OnPaint for windowless rendering and is not implemented by ChromeBrowserHostImpl.

Frame commands carry an actual CefFrame association, are ignored for temporary/detached frames, queue until connection, and discarded on full detachment. Frame identity is not by itself document identity; same-origin reuse is explicit in tests.

CEF ExecuteJavaScript is void, with no playback-result acknowledgement or user-gesture grant. Cross-origin frames can be separately addressed by CEF frame APIs; that is not same-origin DOM traversal and is not a Qt API. cells.name: Download request ownership and admission

cells.api_or_ownership_path: CefRequestContext → CefBrowserContext/Chrome Profile → content::DownloadManager → CEF delegate → originating browser CefClient::GetDownloadHandler. The profile owns transfer machinery, but the public handler is client/browser-scoped rather than a profile-level subscription.
findings: CanDownload is synchronous admission for user-initiated navigation/click downloads; programmatic StartDownload is not covered by it. OnBeforeDownload receives the native item and one-shot destination callback; item wrapper is detached immediately after callback and must not be retained.

Delegate captures DownloadItem→originating-browser once from DownloadItemUtils::GetWebContents, avoiding retargeting when navigation removes the WebContents relation. Source frame/origin is not included in the CEF download handler signature, and GetURL is a transfer URL, not request-origin proof.

Continue consumes its download ID; callback work holds a weak manager, looks item up by ID and rechecks IN_PROGRESS after filename work. ResetManager invalidates outstanding weak pointers. Status updates may precede OnBeforeDownload.

Suggested names go through net::GenerateFileName. An explicit path may create directories; directory-creation failure clears it and falls back to temp/current-directory plus suggested name. show_dialog cannot be treated as unconditional consent enforcement: if no source browser is recoverable, ChooseDownloadPath runs the suggested path directly.

File-dialog callbacks have explicit release-to-cancel semantics, and a native dialog cancellation returns empty path. A stale dialog delegate result checks active_listeners_ before touching the listener; browser destruction destroys file-dialog manager before notifying download observers.

Off-the-record context isolation is separate from transfer admission and separate again from app metadata authorization. CEF has no one-use Feria metadata-grant concept. Same nonempty cache path or explicit CreateContext(other) shares context/storage.

cells.api_or_ownership_path: DownloadItem native state → temporary CefDownloadItem snapshot → host copied projection; separate retained CefDownloadItemCallback resolves manager+ID on UI thread at action time.
findings: Public states distinguish IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CANCELLED, INTERRUPTED and interrupt reason; bytes, rough percent, speed, times and actual full path are available. PercentComplete is documented as -1 for unknown total, not a completed/zero-byte inference.

Cancel and Pause post to UI then act only if item still IN_PROGRESS; Resume posts then checks native CanResume. Cancel resets callback download_id to zero. A completion race cannot be converted into cancellation by these methods because they recheck native state.

The complete public CefDownloadItem interface contains no IsPaused, CanResume, CanOpenDownload, external-file-exists, OpenDownload or ShowDownloadInShell member at this pin. Resume support exists internally but cannot be advertised as a guaranteed public capability from the CEF snapshot.

Interrupted-item Cancel through this callback is a no-op (IN_PROGRESS guard), while Resume can act if native CanResume. Action methods return void, so host needs fresh state/outcome rather than optimistic UI mutation.
cefclient only shows a completion alert with GetFullPath; it does not validate or open a saved file. Native completion and current file availability must remain different state.

cells.name: Download persistence and private cleanup
cells.evidence_status: CEF context/transfer retirement traced; persistence traced in shared targeted Chromium dependency; no CEF restart-resume API
cells.api_or_ownership_path: Source browser can retire independently of DownloadItem. CEF nulls browser association and suppresses callbacks; retained BrowserContext/RequestContext must outlive valid dependent transfers. Chrome Profile owns DownloadCoreService and persistence; off-record excludes DownloadHistory. Colosseum metadata grant/history is a separate app authority.
findings: OnBrowserDestroyed deliberately does not cancel the DownloadItem, but nulls browser mapping: transfer continues silently until complete or browser-context destruction. A stale comment at GetOrAssociateBrowser lines 459–460 says cancel; the actual implementation at 423–433 governs this finding.

Last CefRequestContext removal triggers browser-context shutdown; Chrome off-record context destroys its unique OTR Profile. A browser holds a request-context reference, but a download callback only holds a weak manager, not a keep-alive grant for that context. Closing the final source without another retained context can retire the dependency.

CEF download public API has no enumerate/restore history or durable restart-resume facility. Its Chromium integration creates DownloadHistory only when !profile->IsOffTheRecord. That storage exclusion is not a promise to delete files saved to an explicit destination.

Shared Chromium DownloadHistory distinguishes NOT_PERSISTED/PERSISTING/PERSISTED, uses weak callbacks, handles remove-while-add, ignores vanished manager/item and returns failed insert to NOT_PERSISTED for next-item-update retry without an immediate loop.

Shared Chromium separates ordinary history (terminal/save-package rows) from in-progress DB. Reconstructing native downloads uses GUID, URL chain, storage partition, paths, validators, bytes and slices, not the lightweight Colosseum history row. Metadata alone is not restart-resume.
Private history exclusion must still be enforced in FeriaAccountStore; CEF/Chromium profile isolation cannot authorize writing private metadata into another account store.

cells.name: Save page/link/image/media through native download pipeline
cells.evidence_status: CEF Chrome/Alloy differences and native request/context paths traced; no uniform CEF Save API

sources.api_layer: CEF public embedding API, Chrome style only

sources.symbol: borrowed params and async callback contract
async callback release-to-cancel and one-shot execution

cells.api_or_ownership_path: Chrome-style native context-menu callback retains Chromium RenderViewContextMenu ownership/snapshot and executes native save commands. Link saves create DownloadUrlParameters for actual source RFH and browser-context DownloadManager; image/media saves use actual frame SaveFrameWithHeaders/SaveImageAt; page save enters WebContents::OnSavePage. Programmatic CefBrowserHost::StartDownload creates a main-frame request. Alloy default context menu has no Save page/link/image/media implementation.
findings: Prefer native context snapshots/commands over interpolated script URLs. CEF params are borrowed callback-scoped; GetUnfilteredLinkUrl is explicitly copy-address-only and not validated for navigation/download.

Chrome context callback is single-consumption; dropping it cancels, it binds a weak observer, and model/params/browser state is cleared on close. Its callback-facing GetFrame falls back to main frame after originating frame disappears, but native Chromium save operations retrieve/check the captured RenderFrameHost; do not adopt fallback as permission to retarget.

Chrome link save checks surviving RFH and passes frame process/routing IDs, referrer policy, charset, initiator, suggested filename, prompt=true and CONTEXT_MENU source into the same browser-context manager. At this Chromium pin initiator is derived from frame_url with an upstream TODO to use actual origin: do not upgrade it into stronger proof.

Image/media capability checks distinguish image contents, supported protocol and MediaCanSave; canvas/large-data image uses SaveImageAt, normal image/media passes source frame/referrer/headers to SaveFrameWithHeaders. PDF/print-preview paths are build/feature conditional.

Chrome-style generic ExecuteChromeCommand is supported, but SavePage ultimately targets its Browser active WebContents. It is not a safe substitute for a captured inactive-page context ticket without validating the target.

Alloy CanExecuteChromeCommand returns false and ExecuteChromeCommand is NOTIMPLEMENTED; its default menu switch has no save cases. StartDownload only saves a URL via main-frame association, not complete-page HTML/MHTML or exact subframe native media context. DownloadImage returns bitmap/image data, not a filesystem transfer through CefDownloadHandler.

cells.recommendation: Use receiving Qt public native Save/page/context actions, subject to exact API/build verification by Qt cell, and route to existing profile listener. Retain fresh immutable context/identity/capability ticket with expiry on frame/navigation/menu retirement. Do not introduce CEF, a script URL scraper or another ad hoc downloader.
cells.dependency_footprint: Cef Chrome native context menu relies on CEF integration patches plus Chrome RenderViewContextMenu, UI command framework, content frame/SavePackage/DownloadManager, policy and optional PDF services. Copying is an engine patch with broad dependencies, not a reusable Qt component.

cross_cutting.independence: Shared Chromium integration/history/context-menu source is included to trace actual CEF delegation at its targeted .214 pin. It is not independent corroboration by a third browser.
cross_cutting.colosseum_existing_owner: Baseline findings are supplied by colosseum/findings.json. Existing SessionStore/FeriaPlayback/FeriaBrowserDownloads/FeriaAccountStore remain authoritative; no duplicate transfer/history/profile owner proposed.
cross_cutting.resource_cost: C++ UI-thread callbacks and weak manager+ID tasks are low local overhead; whole CEF would duplicate engine distribution/process/runtime complexity and is outside scope. Copy candidate cones are engine-bound; behavior adaptations avoid that cost. No runtime measurements made.
cross_cutting.portability: CEF C/C++ APIs are portable within CEF distribution constraints, not callable through Qt WebEngine. Chromium internal classes require integration/engine build changes and exact revision upkeep.
